kicker: RSI-Inference Bench, agents tuning serving engines

scenes.headline: How an agent is graded on a real serving engine
scenes.sub: RSI-Inference Bench: 37 tasks on vLLM and SGLang.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Oriel! Apple's new benchmark asks whether coding agents can improve the engines that serve models. Here's how one task is built and graded.

scenes.text: Seal a real engine at a fixed commit, let the agent work offline, then build and serve what it left behind, and measure it.
scenes.mark: build and serve what it left behind
scenes.say: The idea: seal a real engine, let the agent work offline, then build and serve what it left behind, and measure it.

steps.say: Each task starts from a real engine tree at one commit, with its git history, version stamp and file dates removed.
The agent gets that tree, a model and up to eight GPUs, and works offline for about eight hours.
A separate verifier builds the edited tree and the untouched one on the same machine, and serves both.
Day-zero support is pass or fail on hidden checks. Optimization and bug fixes score the measured speed-up.

scenes.title: Making a speed-up honest
scenes.say: A speed-up is a ratio, so the baseline has to be honest.

items.say: First, both trees decode the same prompts. Any difference scores zero.
Warmup runs are thrown away. A cold first run faked a ten percent gain.
Rounds rotate which tree goes first, so neither side carries the slow start.
Each shape takes the median of paired ratios, then the shapes are averaged.
And a guard shape must not get slower, or the run fails.

scenes.title: Day-0 pass@1, ten tasks
scenes.say: The headline, twenty-six point seven percent, is one track: the best agent on the ten day-zero tasks. Half of those tasks nobody passed.

scenes.label: The maintainer's own fix on the FP8 regression task
scenes.note: nine of twelve agents went past it
scenes.say: On the speed-up tasks it flips. Nine of twelve agents beat the maintainer's own fix on this regression.

scenes.text: Landing a new model is still a wall. Making a served model faster already goes past the human fix.
scenes.say: Landing a new model is still a wall. Making a served model faster already goes past the human fix.

recap: A sealed engine and an offline agent
Support is hard; speed-ups beat fixes
scenes.say: A sealed engine, honest benches, and two very different answers.
